summary: Acer Nitro V16 ANV16-41-R2ZN experiencing battery drain issues during gaming, likely due to underpowered PSU. Recommended upgrades and modifications.
detected_fault: Underpowered power supply unit (PSU) not sufficient for hardware configuration
suggested_solution: Upgrade to a more powerful PSU (230W or higher), download and install BIOS version 1.04, and modify platform.ini file
